text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is an original research paper focused on spatial prediction of future land use/land cover (LULC) changes in Lithuania at the national scale. It implements four distinct future scenarios (business as usual, urbanisation, land abandonment and afforestation, and agricultural intensification) with quantitative spatial modeling using Cellular Automata (CA) and Dinamica EGO software. The study includes spatially explicit LULC projections mapped at 100 m resolution for the entire country, accompanied by accuracy validation (80% agreement for 2018 prediction) and quantitative change analyses. It also assesses impacts on habitat quality, but the primary objective and central research question are clearly LULC prediction and scenario comparison at the national level. The study meets all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria. Therefore, it is categorized as OK.)
